verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting, bookkeeping and tax service rather than a coding agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions an MCP server, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Mentions of in-app AI answers and third-party integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
